masor-tenga.name: Masor Tenga
masor-tenga.desc: A light and sour traditional Assamese fish curry prepared with cross-cut drying of garcinia pedunculata (thekera tenga), tomatoes, outenga, or fresh lemon. Features fresh local pond, lake, or river fish cooked with minimal mustard oil, offering high omega-3s with very few calories.

omita-khar.name: Omita Khar
omita-khar.desc: A signature Assamese dish made from green papaya cooked with 'kolkhar'—an alkaline extract filtered from the ashes of sun-dried banana peels. It is traditionally eaten at the start of a meal to soothe the digestive system.

evidence.sourceNote: Discrepancy between 65 kcal in app food-db vs 55 kcal in recipe guide/cards for 150g serving. Unresolved pending standardized recipe calculation. Values kept as pending_review without guessing.

aloo-pitika.name: Aloo Pitika
aloo-pitika.desc: Comforting mashed potatoes mixed with raw onions, green chilies, and a drizzle of raw mustard oil. Simple, warming, and packed with carbohydrate energy.

evidence.sourceNote: Approved standard prep calorie basis = 90 kcal / 100g (boiled potato + raw mustard oil drizzle + onion/chili). Macro breakdown flagged pending definitive assay.

mati-dal.name: Mati Dal
mati-dal.desc: Slow-cooked split black lentils simmered with ginger, garlic, and wild coriander. Creamy and hearty without any heavy cream or butter.

dhekia-sak.name: Dhekia Sak Bhaji
dhekia-sak.desc: Tender fiddlehead ferns wild-foraged from regional riverbanks, stir-fried with tiny potato strips and garlic. High in iron, dietary fiber, and essential minerals.

haah-kumura.name: Haah Kumura
haah-kumura.desc: A rustic, slow-cooked traditional Assamese duck curry prepared with fresh winter ash gourd (Chal Kumura), fresh ginger, garlic, and whole spices. Hearty, rich in iron, and deeply comforting.

gahori-bhaji.name: Local Gahori Bhaji
gahori-bhaji.desc: Local pork cuts dry-fried with green chilies, ginger paste, and regional herbs. It delivers high-quality protein and rich flavors with a traditional crispy finish.

masor-poora.name: Goroi Masor Poora
masor-poora.desc: Fresh local pond or lake mudfish (Goroi fish) marinated with fresh green chilies, raw mustard oil, and coriander, wrapped in a banana leaf and slow-grilled over hot embers for an authentic smoky flavor.

til-pitha.name: Til Pitha
til-pitha.desc: A delicate, cylindrical roasted rice cake wrapper stuffed with a sweet, roasted black sesame seed and jaggery filling. A classic Bihu festival treat.

evidence.sourceNote: Assam Agricultural University / IJTK published composition: 365.88 kcal, 9.81g P, 50.11g C, 14.02g F per 100g. Derived 30g piece = ~110 kcal.

ghila-pitha.name: Ghila Pitha
ghila-pitha.desc: A fried sweet rice cake flavored with liquid jaggery, crisp on the outside and soft inside. High in carbohydrates and ideal for moderate energy snacking.

komal-saul.name: Komal Saul
komal-saul.desc: A unique, native variety of precooked soft rice that needs only simple soaking in cold water. Served with cream (doi) and jaggery for a traditional breakfast.

bora-saul.name: Bora Saul
bora-saul.desc: Traditional Assamese glutinous sticky rice. Rich in amylopectin starch, it yields a sticky texture and is highly valued for Bihu pithas and traditional breakfast treats.

evidence.sourceNote: Cooked waxy glutinous rice with high amylopectin starch content (180 kcal / 150g cooked katori).

joha-rice.name: Joha Rice
joha-rice.desc: Premium indigenous aromatic rice variety from Assam, known for its sweet scent, high antioxidants, and excellent export-quality taste.

evidence.sourceNote: Cooked aromatic indigenous Assam short/medium-grain rice (150 kcal / 150g cooked katori).

bao-dhan.name: Bao Dhan
bao-dhan.desc: Deepwater red rice from the Brahmaputra floodplain. Packed with anthocyanin antioxidants, iron, and trace zinc. Recognized globally as a nutrient-dense superfood.

evidence.sourceNote: Cooked Assam deep-water red rice rich in mineral ash and anthocyanins (155 kcal / 150g cooked katori).

pork-bamboo-shoot.name: Pork with Bamboo Shoot
pork-bamboo-shoot.desc: A beloved Naga dish of tender pork slow-cooked in its own natural juices with fermented bamboo shoots and fiery king chilies. Oil-free, smoky, and intensely savory.

baah-gaj-tenga.name: Baah Gaj Tenga
baah-gaj-tenga.desc: A refreshing, tangy vegetarian broth prepared with fermented bamboo shoots, tomatoes, and regional wild herbs. It is light, sour, and helps cleanse the digestive tract.

smoked-chicken-herbs.name: Smoked Chicken with Herbs
smoked-chicken-herbs.desc: Chicken pieces smoked over firewood, then simmered with local forest greens, ginger, and garlic. Lean protein with a deep, rustic woodfire aroma.

eromba.name: Eromba
eromba.desc: A traditional Manipuri dish prepared by boiling vegetables, potatoes, and mushrooms, mashed together with fermented fish paste and fiery chilies. An aromatic, oil-free delicacy.

naga-galho.name: Naga Galho
naga-galho.desc: A hearty Naga soupy rice dish slow-cooked with fresh local seasonal greens, ginger, garlic, and optional smoked pork, creating a wholesome, comforting, and warming meal.

naga-boiled-veg.name: Naga Boiled Vegetables
naga-boiled-veg.desc: A traditional oil-free preparation of native leafy greens boiled with a pinch of salt and local Sichuan peppercorns, supporting digestive health with zero added fats.

manipuri-singju.name: Manipuri Singju
manipuri-singju.desc: A spicy, oil-free Manipuri salad made with finely shredded cabbage, seasonal herbs, lotus stems, and banana inflorescence, dressed in toasted chickpea powder and fermented fish paste.

manipuri-kangshoi.name: Manipuri Kangshoi
manipuri-kangshoi.desc: A simple, comforting boiled vegetable soup prepared with seasonal greens, sliced onions, ginger, and dried fish (ngari), cooked completely without oil.

khasi-jadoh.name: Khasi Jadoh
khasi-jadoh.desc: A classic Khasi festival rice dish cooked with short-grain red rice, ginger, black pepper, and minced pork or chicken, featuring a deep, earthy spiced flavor.

khasi-dohneiiong.name: Khasi Dohneiiong
khasi-dohneiiong.desc: A highly aromatic Khasi pork curry slow-cooked with toasted black sesame paste, ginger, garlic, and local spices, creating a rich and savory dark gravy.

roti.name: Plain Roti / Chapatis
roti.desc: Whole wheat flatbread rolled thin and puffed over an open flame. A staple source of complex carbohydrates and dietary fiber for steady metabolic energy.

steamed-rice.name: Steamed Basmati Rice
steamed-rice.desc: Light and fluffy long-grain white rice, steam-cooked. Easy to digest and a perfect base for regional fish curries and lentil soups.

brown-basmati-rice.name: Brown Basmati Rice
brown-basmati-rice.desc: Whole grain basmati rice retaining its outer bran layer. High in fiber, trace minerals, and offers a nuttier flavor with a lower glycemic index.

dal-tadka.name: Dal Tadka
dal-tadka.desc: Yellow pigeon pea lentils boiled with turmeric, then tempered with a touch of ghee, cumin seeds, garlic, and dried red chilies. Great source of plant protein.

boiled-egg.name: Boiled Egg
boiled-egg.desc: A whole egg boiled until firm. An excellent and convenient source of high-quality complete protein and essential healthy fats.

mug-dal.name: Mug Dal (Moong Dal)
mug-dal.desc: Yellow split mung bean soup slow-cooked with ginger and mild spices. A light, nutritious, and easily digestible source of plant protein.

masoor-dal.name: Masor Dal (Masoor Dal)
masoor-dal.desc: Split red lentil soup simmered with tomatoes, turmeric, and local tempering. Highly nutritious, low in fat, and rich in essential minerals.

masor-dal.name: Masor Dal (Masoor Dal)
masor-dal.desc: Split red lentil soup simmered with tomatoes, turmeric, and local tempering. Highly nutritious, low in fat, and rich in essential minerals.

chicken-biryani.name: Chicken Biryani
chicken-biryani.desc: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced marinated chicken, cooked on slow dum heat. Rich in aromatic herbs like mint and saffron.

butter-chicken.name: Butter Chicken
butter-chicken.desc: Tender tandoori-grilled chicken pieces simmered in a mildly spiced, velvety tomato gravy enriched with butter and cream. Satisfying and protein-dense.

dosa-sambar.name: Masala Dosa with Sambar
dosa-sambar.desc: A crispy fermented rice crepe folded over a spiced potato filling, paired with vegetable-lentil soup. A popular South Indian breakfast that balances energy and proteins.

evidence.sourceNote: Standard plain fermented rice-lentil crepe (~125 kcal) + 1 cup vegetable-lentil sambar (~110 kcal) = ~235-240 kcal.

idli.name: Idli
idli.desc: Fluffy, steamed savory cakes made from a fermented batter of black lentils and rice. Light, highly digestible, and rich in prebiotic gut benefits.

fish-fry.name: Fish Fry (Indian Style)
fish-fry.desc: River or marine fish steaks marinated in daily ground spices, then pan-fried in raw mustard oil until golden and crispy.

veg-pulao.name: Veg Pulao
veg-pulao.desc: A light, aromatic rice dish prepared by cooking basmati rice with mixed vegetables, cardamom, cloves, and a touch of clarified butter.

dhokla.name: Dhokla
dhokla.desc: A soft, spongy steamed snack prepared from fermented gram flour batter, tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies.

litti-chokha.name: Litti Chokha
litti-chokha.desc: Roasted whole wheat dough balls stuffed with spiced roasted gram flour (sattu), served alongside a traditional smoky mash of eggplant, potatoes, and tomatoes.

shorshe-ilish.name: Shorshe Ilish
shorshe-ilish.desc: Bengali style Hilsa fish steak cooked in a pungent mustard paste gravy with green chilies and a drizzle of raw mustard oil. Rich in healthy omega-3 fatty acids.

luchi-alur-dom.name: Luchi with Alur Dom
luchi-alur-dom.desc: Deep-fried, puffed white flour flatbreads (Luchi) served with a rich, slow-simmered, spicy potato gravy (Alur Dom). A classic Bengali breakfast delicacy.

rava-upma.name: Rava Upma
rava-upma.desc: A comforting South Indian breakfast made of dry-roasted semolina cooked with hot water, mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilies, and mixed seasonal vegetables.

brisk-walking.name: Brisk Walking
brisk-walking.desc: A moderate-intensity walk that gets your heart pumping. Helps regulate blood glucose levels and enhances daily active calorie burn safely.

cardio-running.name: Cardio Running
cardio-running.desc: High-intensity aerobic running. Excellent for boosting cardiovascular health, metabolic efficiency, and burning off target calories.

gym-resistance.name: Gym & Resistance Drill
gym-resistance.desc: Strength training or circuit bodyweight drills. Stimulates muscle growth and elevates baseline metabolism (BMR) even when resting.

cycling-exercise.name: Cycling Exercise
cycling-exercise.desc: Steady-state cycling. A great lower-body muscular exercise that burns calories with minimal strain on your joints.

active-house-duties.name: Active House Duties
active-house-duties.desc: General household physical tasks like sweeping, mopping, or gardening. Contributes to your daily non-exercise physical activity (NEAT).

samosa.name: Samosa
samosa.desc: A golden-fried, triangular pastry shell filled with spiced mashed potatoes, green peas, and fresh cilantro. Crisp and calorie-dense.

pani-puri.name: Pani Puri / Puchka
pani-puri.desc: Hollow, crispy semolina shells filled with spiced potato-chickpea mash, dipped in chilled tangy mint and sweet tamarind water. A sweet, sour, and spicy treat.

pav-bhaji.name: Pav Bhaji
pav-bhaji.desc: A popular Mumbai street food featuring a spicy vegetable mash cooked with spices and butter, served with soft toasted buns.

chole-bhature.name: Chole Bhature
chole-bhature.desc: Spicy, tangy chickpea curry served alongside a puffed, deep-fried leavened bread. Rich in spices, flavor, and calories.

chicken-momos.name: Chicken Momos (Steamed)
chicken-momos.desc: Thin flour wrappers stuffed with spiced minced chicken, steamed to perfection and served with a zesty, hot chili dipping sauce.

jalebi.name: Jalebi
jalebi.desc: Crispy spiral-shaped batter rings deep-fried and soaked in a warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. A classic celebratory sweet treat.

mumbai-vada-pav.name: Mumbai Vada Pav
mumbai-vada-pav.desc: The quintessential Mumbai street snack featuring a spiced, deep-fried mashed potato dumpling inside a soft pav bun, layered with sweet and spicy garlic dry chutneys.

mumbai-misal-pav.name: Mumbai Misal Pav
mumbai-misal-pav.desc: A fiery, sprouted moth bean curry (usal) topped with crispy farsan mix, raw onions, and coriander, served with buttered soft pav buns and lemon wedges.

medu-vada.name: Medu Vada
medu-vada.desc: A crispy, deep-fried savory doughnut made from a seasoned black lentil batter with crushed black pepper, fresh ginger, and curry leaves. High in plant protein.

milk-tea-sugar.name: Milk Tea (with Sugar)
milk-tea-sugar.desc: Assam black tea brewed with fresh milk and sweetened with cane sugar. Rich, comforting, and a daily ritual for millions.

black-tea.name: Black Tea / Lal Saah
black-tea.desc: A robust cup of pure brewed Assam black tea leaves. Clean, aromatic, and comforting without any added milk or sugar.

sweet-lassi.name: Sweet Lassi
sweet-lassi.desc: A thick, creamy yogurt beverage blended with sugar and a hint of cardamom or rose water, served chilled for instant refreshment.
